ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring and AI-powered land compliance platform tailored for assessing agricultural zoning violations and land-use changes in Uttarakhand.
ideas.title: AgriCompliance-Dehradun
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the winning GeoNex-ATLAS project by applying satellite monitoring to industrial and agricultural land compliance, addressing regional environmental governance problems judges care about.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven patient acquisition and trust verification engine designed for local tier-2 and tier-3 clinics and doctors across India.
ideas.title: MedTrust-India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the Global-Smile prize-winning formula for local medical markets, providing clear measurable economic benefit to healthcare providers in the region.

ideas.pitch: Community-driven matching application that groups elderly residents in hilly terrains for social outings and coordinates volunteer student drivers.
ideas.title: ElderRoute-Dehradun
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the proven Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon grand prize formula to solve a localized mobility and social isolation problem for seniors.

ideas.pitch: Hyper-local nutrition and wellness platform delivering customized meal recommendations and caloric insights based on traditional Indian regional diets.
ideas.title: NutriLocal-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the exact winning concept of the E-Foodiee AI Nutrition Assistant, targeting a massive audience familiar with Indian dietary habits.

ideas.pitch: Graph intelligence and risk-scoring platform to detect suspicious micro-transactions and prevent financial fraud in digital wallet ecosystems.
ideas.title: FinGuard-AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs hard graph intelligence techniques similar to the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner, appealing to fintech judges looking for robust security logic.
